source.name: Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife — 2025 game harvest reports, "Individual hunts" (special permit) tables, joined to the 2025 Big Game Hunting Regulations pamphlet

notes: WDFW 2025 special hunt permit draw (held June 2025 for the 2025-26 seasons). Applicants and permits come from WDFW's 2025 game harvest report pages, which list every special permit hunt with "Total Applicants" and "Permits Issued": https://wdfw.wa.gov/hunting/management/game-harvest/2025/deer-individual ; https://wdfw.wa.gov/hunting/management/game-harvest/2025/elk-individual ; https://wdfw.wa.gov/hunting/management/game-harvest/2025/moose ; https://wdfw.wa.gov/hunting/management/game-harvest/2025/mountain-goat ; https://wdfw.wa.gov/hunting/management/game-harvest/2025/bighorn-sheep . huntCode = WDFW 4-digit hunt choice number for 2025 (hunt numbers can change from year to year). GMU(s), weapon, legal animal, category and dates come from the 2025 pamphlet special permit tables (https://wdfw.wa.gov/sites/default/files/publications/02608/wdfw02608.pdf), joined on hunt choice number (the hunt names matched on every joined row). tags = Permits Issued (can be below the quota when a hunt had fewer takers or permits were returned); applicants = Total Applicants. successPct = Permits Issued / Total Applicants x 100 (1 decimal, 2 decimals under 1%). It is NOT a first-choice draw rate: WDFW does not say whether Total Applicants counts every applicant who listed the hunt at any choice, and up to 4 choices are allowed (2 for quality deer/elk). WDFW publishes no residency split and no separate nonresident quota was found; residents and nonresidents apply in the same weighted (squared) point draw, so the same combined numbers are given for resident and nonresident. No points-to-draw tables or minimum points are published per hunt, so pointLines and minPoints are left out. unit = first GMU (3-digit string, matches WDFW GMU_Num) when the hunt lists GMUs; otherwise the agency's own area name ("Elk Area 1015", "Deer Area 4541", "Region 1", "Centralia Mine"). Moose units are GMUs (Mt Spokane hunts are Moose Area 1/2 within GMU 124, see label). Bighorn sheep units are "Sheep Unit N" (WDFW BSU_ID N) except Wenaha (GMU 169). Mountain goat units use WDFW goat-unit codes ("3-6", "5-4" = MGU_Nu_Code). "GMUs 127-142" (hunt 1200 Palouse) is stored as unit 127 with the range in the label. season is set only for a single continuous date range; split seasons are in the label. Weapon: modern firearm tags (Modern, EF, WF) = rifle; archery (EA, WA) = archery; muzzleloader (EM, WM) = muzzleloader; hunts open to several tag types, "Any", and all moose/goat/sheep (any legal weapon) = any. Left out: the multi-season deer/elk tag drawings (1998, 1999, 2998, 2999; statewide, no unit), raffles, auctions and the incentive-permit drawing. 2026 draw statistics were not yet published per hunt when this was built (2026-10-07). General (over-the-counter) seasons: one row per GMU and weapon from the 2025 general-season harvest pages, huntCode "GEN-<GMU>-<weapon>", otc true, no draw; their hunter success is the matching harvest row.
